headline: Net income jumps on favorable swings as core earnings hold
summary_short: Lincoln Financial's Q2 2026 net income rose to $1,332M ($6.72 diluted EPS) from $699M a year earlier, a swing the company attributes mainly to favorable non-economic market risk benefit movements, while adjusted operating income was $450M versus $438M a year ago.
summary_long: Total revenues were $4,542M, up 12.3% y/y. Net income was $1,332M ($6.72 diluted EPS), up 90.6% y/y, while adjusted operating income — the company's core profitability measure — was $450M ($2.24/share), just above $438M a year ago; management attributes the gap to non-economic market risk benefit swings. By segment: Annuities held flat at $287M; Life Insurance rose to $57M on favorable mortality; Group Protection fell to $147M against a stronger prior-year experience refund; Retirement Plan Services rose 32% to $49M. Total cash rose to $10,165M and equity to $11,349M q/q, aided by a $500M subordinated debt issuance completed June 29. No forward guidance was issued.
